whatTheyArgued: Habitual perception becomes automatic and deadens experience; art's device is to make things unfamiliar and to make forms difficult, increasing the length and difficulty of perception, since perception is itself the aesthetic end (via secondary sources; I could not read a primary text).

scholarship.disputes: weak source; page records translation variants of the title and key terms; I did not read a peer-reviewed treatment
